lines.text: Photos shows a RAW and its JPEG as one photo, marked RAW+JPEG; the editor opens the RAW.
Give a photo stars or a heart: hold it on the shelf, or swipe up on it in the editor.
Chips on the shelf show only favourites, 4 stars or more, RAW, edited and more.
In the editor, swipe left or right to go through your photos while you pick the best.
